title: Orchestrator must support specifying distinct AI models per skill invocation
description: Different skills (spec, run, fix_signal) benefit from different model capabilities and cost profiles. Currently there is no mechanism to specify which model to use for each skill invocation — all use whatever the default adapter provides. Using distinct models per skill (e.g. a more capable model for spec authoring, a faster model for fix_signal) requires orchestrator-level support. This signal is reframed from a CLI concern to an orchestrator concern, gated on the orchestrator architecture being defined.
proposed_resolution: As part of the orchestrator design (gated on a1000052 run-auditor and a1000060 retry loop), add model selection to the skill invocation contract: each skill invocation accepts an optional model parameter. The orchestrator selects the model based on skill type and a configurable model-routing policy in config.toml. Document the routing policy format and add a test that verifies the correct model is passed to query_agent for each skill type.
